local_inventory.method: published ops_glob eligible files, excludes symlinks/hidden/runtime/dependency scope

local_supplement_capability.supported: original_text/original_image/page_render only when all exact local targets already exist and hash/type/locator/scope validate
local_supplement_capability.journal: existing publications plus one local_supplement_deliveries table in same business SQLite
local_supplement_capability.recovery: prepared/unknown only reconcile exact existing publication; no blind republish
local_supplement_capability.post_accepted_proposals: Analysis.request_supplement verifies get_result and schema, leaves old accepted immutable, emits task/publish/request SHA-bound supplement_requested

boundaries: No new download probe or signed URL export, no commercial/generation request, no old material deletion/move/overwrite, no production-media or real-XLSX acceptance fabricated.
remaining: Actual authorized local media/XLSX inventory is absent; protected course download and meaningful external verification remain unavailable. Crop/audio-window/new OCR/table supplementation is not covered by this narrow existing-evidence delivery and must remain unsupported until implemented and verified.
